 So Arsenal have now lost their last two penalty shootouts against PSG in the Champions League final and Fleetwood in the fourth round of the League Cup.

 FT: Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal (5-3 pens) 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 He had such a stop and start run up to that.
 Guimaraes was never going to generate the power, and he certainly didn't con the goalkeeper into going the wrong way. 
 Comfortable save in the end.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 22:16 GMT 22:16 GMT 
 FT: Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal (5-3 pens) 
 Arsenal had 78% of the ball, 26 shots, seven on target and 59 touches in the Fleetwood box but they couldn't get past the League Two side.

 Post published at 22:15 GMT 22:15 GMT 
 FT: Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal (5-3 pens) 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter 
 An incredible upset. 
 A terrible performance from Arsenal. There was enough quality in their side to get a win this evening. They just did not perform.

 Post published at 22:13 GMT 22:13 GMT 
 FT: Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal (5-3 pens) 
 Fleetwood boss Matt Lawlor is from just down the road and you can see exactly what it means to him. 
 His side are in the QUARTER-FINALS of the League Cup.

 Conor Haughey 
 FLEETWOOD HAVE BEATEN ARSENAL!
 One of the biggest League Cup shocks we've seen. 
 Conor Haughey sends Illan Meslier the wrong way and fires his side into the Carabao Cup quarter-finals.

 Fleetwood Town pulled off one of the biggest upsets in Carabao Cup history as they beat Premier League champions Arsenal in an astounding penalty shootout to reach the quarter-finals. 
 More to follow.
